bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Ethereum and Celo are issuer-native USAT deployments in the reserve report. Their transfer rail is a LayerZero V2 lock/mint path: the Ethereum OFTAdapter escrows Ethereum USAT, and the Celo OFT calls the token's authorized crosschain mint/burn functions. Independent owner-only mint and immediate token/OFT upgrades remain issuer-controlled bypasses; three required DVNs do not constrain those powers. Runtime per-chain materiality remains separately unresolved.

routes.protocol: Anchorage issuer-native USAT with LayerZero V2 OFT
routes.reviewNote: The reserve report calls Celo tokens natively minted, and verified CeloOFTExtension exposes independent owner-only mint as well as OFT-authorized crosschainMint/crosschainBurn. Ethereum adapter 0x18171f318a49051301c3422b6042fca2d8be43df locks/releases native Ethereum USAT; reciprocal peers connect it to Celo OFT 0xc8f467e1ba04ffdeca1cd1878ca3416d84045d0e. This native issuer liability must not be misclassified as an immutable wrapped token.
